scope: Full-package downloader, SHA-256, safe new-directory extraction, UI integration and package metadata generation. Remote publication/mirror discovery remains phase 3.

build.method: Incremental module rebuild from beta.16; all changed source files recompiled; download test target built separately

additional_scale_runs.renderer: Qt offscreen; not native OS DPI validation

skip_reasons: Qt6 qmake not on default PATH; explicit Qt6 path used for application builds

packaging_syntax.powershell: not executed in this Linux environment

coverage: identical-package source fallback and manual source lock
timeout and cancellation including progress/extraction transitions
occupied destination including creation during download
path traversal, reserved names, duplicate/case collision, symlink escape/loop rejection
internal Unix symlink and executable mode preservation
real Qt mouse selection of destination, download and Escape close
legacy release without metadata retains manual path

findings.issue: Qt canonicalFilePath alone did not reject a self-referential symlink in the test environment
findings.fix: Require existing resolved link target within package root; loop regression passes

findings.issue: Cancellation from a progress signal could invalidate the current reply before the next read
findings.fix: Check reply/busy state after progress callbacks; direct cancellation regression passes

not_run: disk-full injection and large-package performance benchmark
remaining: channel indexes allowing version discovery without GitHub
